source_quote: Glypromate® has a plasma half-life of less than 5 min in rats [16]
source_location: Introduction, para 2 (also Discussion para 1: 'elimination half-life from blood of less than 5 min [16]')
notes: CITED_NOT_MEASURED: value is quoted from ref 16 (Batchelor 2003), not measured here; upper bound only ('<5 min'), label 5 min equals the bound. Route of the cited value not stated; the paper's own PK is for the analogue NNZ-2566 (49 min blood), not Glypromate.
